name: Trigenys Insight
tagline: Publish source-traceable research in French and English through one editorial newsroom, rather than treating every article as an isolated page.
problem: Technology and business news can be fast yet shallow when sources, translations, media, distribution and corrections are handled in disconnected tools. An independent publication needs a reproducible research workflow as well as a clear public experience.
scenario: A researcher registers verifiable sources, creates a French or English draft in the authenticated CMS, attaches charts and media, reviews SEO and publication scheduling, then distributes approved public content through separate social workflows.
differentiation: A unified Next.js + Payload publication couples public research, authoring, bilingual editorial objects and an authenticated REST/SDK/MCP automation boundary while keeping source registries and publishing credentials private.
architecture: Public Next.js 16 site and Payload CMS -> authenticated editorial REST/GraphQL + SDK/MCP -> PostgreSQL on Neon, media in Vercel Blob, scheduled publishing -> controlled external distribution via Buffer with independently tracked draft and schedule states.
limitations: A deployed CMS does not demonstrate a guaranteed publication cadence, subscriber conversion, factual correctness or delivery to social channels. Social drafts are not scheduled by default; editorial review and provider receipts remain essential.

capabilities.name: Localized editorial CMS
capabilities.description: Manage localized articles, source references, author/category metadata, media, drafts and scheduling.

capabilities.name: SDK and MCP publishing
capabilities.description: Expose authenticated authoring operations through an HTTP API and reusable automation clients.

capabilities.name: Buffer distribution
capabilities.description: Create and schedule external social drafts with explicit authorization and receipt-state checks.

capabilities.name: Research computation
capabilities.description: Evaluate reproducible analysis engines outside browser presentation components.

roadmap.name: Reliable editorial cadence
roadmap.exitCriteria: A verified run demonstrates scheduled article publication, language consistency, editorial review and correct failure handling.

roadmap.name: Measurable discoverability
roadmap.exitCriteria: Publish source-backed SEO observations and distinguish impressions, clicks and sampled reports from audience promises.

references.name: Publishing automation architecture
references.relevance: Authenticated CMS, SDK/MCP and bilingual publication contract.

references.name: RAIDER README assurance
references.relevance: Consumer-owned narrative and evidence-backed maturity checks.

presentation.headline: Research deserves a newsroom. Not just a feed.
presentation.summary: An independent bilingual publication and source-aware editorial platform for African technology, digital business and systems that shape decisions.
